# `AutoGotoStep`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mount-error notification raised during an auto-goto step.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyMountErr @0x16ede0 (64-bit build) |

Custom producer NotifyMountErr, called when the mount reports an error during auto-goto. state is the literal fail and the event carries tag, page, func, count, error and code; presence conditions for the individual members are not detailed in the evidence, so only state is marked required. Channel I (TCP 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. APK 3.3.2 defines the name as a constant only; no consumer branch is established.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AutoGotoStep"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `tag` | string | no | - | Source tag. [READ] |
| `page` | string | no | - | Page. [READ] |
| `func` | string | no | - | Goto function step name. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Always fail in the inspected producer. One of: `fail`. [READ] |
| `count` | integer | no | - | Attempt count. [READ] |
| `error` | string | no | - | Message from the error lookup. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | no | - | Mount failure code. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, fail - Mount error during goto (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AutoGotoStep","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","tag":"example","page":"preview","func":"example","state":"fail","count":1,"error":"example error","code":207}
```
